nodes.description: Public upgrade() entry point that orchestrates ownership claims, storage migration and delegation between oldTrueUSD, newTrueUSD and tokenController through a sequence of unchecked external calls.
Constant interface handle to the legacy TrueUSD contract whose ownership, storage children and delegate target are migrated.
Constant interface handle to the new TrueUSD contract that receives totalSupply, child contracts and ownership.
Constant interface handle to the TokenController which ends up owning both TUSD contracts and claims storage children.
Constant registry address pushed into the controller via setTusdRegistry.
Constant global pause address (zero address) pushed into the controller via setGlobalPause.
Address returned by tokenController.owner(); final owner that receives controller ownership at the end of upgrade.
Address of the balance sheet storage child returned by oldTrueUSD.balances(), reclaimed and transferred to the new contract.
Address of the allowance sheet storage child returned by oldTrueUSD.allowances(), reclaimed and transferred to the new contract.
External call tokenController.owner() whose return value determines the pending/final owner (endOwner).
External call that makes the helper the owner of the TokenController; ownership state changes before later external calls complete.
External call that makes the helper the owner of the new TrueUSD contract.
External call that makes the helper the owner of the legacy TrueUSD contract before delegating.
External call redirecting the legacy TrueUSD delegate target to the new contract; a privileged state change on an external legacy contract.
External call handing controller ownership back to endOwner; final ownership-sensitive external interaction.
External calls issuing claim of the reclaimed storage children (balance sheet and allowance sheet) so the controller owns them.

edges.reason: upgrade() reads the constant oldTrueUSD interface to invoke legacy contract functions.
upgrade() reads the constant newTrueUSD interface to invoke new contract functions.
upgrade() reads the constant tokenController interface to perform all controller operations.
upgrade() uses the registry constant as argument to setTusdRegistry.
upgrade() uses the globalPause constant as argument to setGlobalPause.
upgrade() stores the value of tokenController.owner() into the local endOwner.
upgrade() stores the value of oldTrueUSD.balances() into the local balanceSheetAddress.
upgrade() stores the value of oldTrueUSD.allowances() into the local allowanceSheetAddress.
upgrade() calls tokenController.owner() to determine the final owner.
Return value of external tokenController.owner() flows into local variable endOwner.
upgrade() performs the external claimOwnership call on the controller, an external interaction occurring before all state settling completes.
upgrade() performs the external claimOwnership call on the new TrueUSD contract.
upgrade() performs the external claimOwnership call on the legacy TrueUSD contract.
upgrade() performs the external delegateToNewContract call on the legacy contract that can redirect all balances.
upgrade() performs the external transferOwnership call on the controller as the final action.
upgrade() performs external issueClaimOwnership calls for the reclaimed storage contracts.
Local endOwner is passed as the _newOwner argument to tokenController.transferOwnership.
The tokenController state variable supplies the receiver for the claimOwnership external call.
The newTrueUSD state variable supplies the receiver for the claimOwnership external call.
The oldTrueUSD state variable supplies the receiver for the claimOwnership external call.
The oldTrueUSD state variable supplies the receiver for the delegateToNewContract external call.
balanceSheetAddress is passed as the _child argument to tokenController.issueClaimOwnership.
allowanceSheetAddress is passed as the _child argument to tokenController.issueClaimOwnership.
The external claimOwnership call on the controller can re-enter upgrade() and observe an inconsistent ownership/migration state.
The external delegateToNewContract call runs external code that can re-enter upgrade() before ownership is finalised.
The external transferOwnership call can invoke a reentrant owner and re-enter upgrade() during the untrusted external call.
External issueClaimOwnership calls can execute contract code that re-enters upgrade() mid-migration.

normalization_plan.reason: The local endOwner exists only to carry the owner address read from the controller into the final transferOwnership external call, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
The local balanceSheetAddress is derived from oldTrueUSD.balances() and is consumed by the issueClaimOwnership and transferChild external calls, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
The local allowanceSheetAddress is derived from oldTrueUSD.allowances() and is consumed by the issueClaimOwnership and transferChild external calls, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
